entries.speaker: Metatron
entries.en: The power of the chancellor of heaven[n]shall become thy mask and striketh[n]down the army of darkness...

entries.speaker: Beelzebub
entries.en: My demonic powers are gonna become[n]your new mask and show everyone[n]what hell really is!

entries.speaker: Cu Chulainn
entries.en: My magic spear shall bring a rain of[n]blood. Now, let me be your mask!

entries.speaker: Jack-o'-Lantern
entries.en: It looks like I'm barred from hell,[n]so I guess I'll have to be your mask[n]instead, ho!

entries.speaker: Jack Frost
entries.en: I know I'm just a mask, but take[n]good care of me-hee, ho!

entries.speaker: Pixie
entries.en: I'm going to be your mask and[n]have some fun!

entries.speaker: Cerberus
entries.en: Me become your mask. Me guide you[n]through other world.

entries.speaker: Lilim
entries.en: I'll leave the realm of dreams for[n]a while and become your mask...

entries.speaker: Eligor
entries.en: I shall become your mask. Let the days[n]of war and love commence...

entries.speaker: Odin
entries.en: This might for which I traded mine own[n]eye shall be a mask of thine soul and[n]lead thee to battle.

entries.speaker: Hua Po
entries.en: For the sake of you who still lives,[n]I shall become a mask...

entries.speaker: Decarabia
entries.en: The power of my star-shaped body[n]shall now become a mask of yours.

entries.speaker: Mara
entries.en: ...You cannot hide it from me. Those[n]inner desires are but another of your[n]façades.

entries.speaker: Ose
entries.en: In this world between rational thought[n]and insanity, I will be your mask. I will[n]guide you.

entries.speaker: Thor
entries.en: The might of my hammer shall find[n]a new home within your mask.

entries.speaker: Unicorn
entries.en: Me become your mask, protect you[n]from unclean thing.

entries.speaker: Uriel
entries.en: I, the executor of justice, am now[n]within your mask.

entries.speaker: Sarasvati
entries.en: The melody of the heart... It shall[n]become your mask and be with you...

entries.speaker: Valkyrie
entries.en: The courage to stand up to even death[n]itself shall now become a part of your[n]mask!

entries.speaker: Yaksini
entries.en: I will become your mask and consume[n]those who stand against you...

entries.speaker: Ganesha
entries.en: You have my mask. There's no doubt[n]good luck will come to you now!

entries.speaker: Anubis
entries.en: I shall become a mask and bring help[n]to your marvelous soul.

entries.speaker: Mot
entries.en: I wish for a battle in which my life is[n]on the line... Hence, I shall join you[n]as a new mask...

entries.speaker: Raphael
entries.en: I shall become a mask and provide[n]support for your health, both mentally[n]and physically.

entries.speaker: Scathach
entries.en: I will become a new mask for you and[n]grant discipline to your soul.

entries.speaker: High Pixie
entries.en: They don't call me a "High Pixie" for[n]nothing! I'll be your mask and show[n]you the real reason why!

entries.speaker: Barong
entries.en: As your new mask, I will protect you[n]from any impending calamities.

entries.speaker: Girimehkala
entries.en: The radiant light and somber darkness[n]within me are both within your mask[n]now.

entries.speaker: King Frost
entries.en: Your enemies are my enemies, ho![n]I'll become a mask and free-hee-ze[n]them solid, ho!

entries.speaker: Narcissus
entries.en: By becoming one with my mask,[n]you have gained the visage of true[n]beauty, both inner and outer.

entries.speaker: Isis
entries.en: You are the one who rests on the[n]throne of this world... My mask is[n]proof of that fact.

entries.speaker: Lamia
entries.en: I am the flames of vengeance...[n]Any who oppose us shall be singed[n]by the fire now within your mask.

entries.speaker: Legion
entries.en: The immense might of my army is[n]now one with your mask...

entries.speaker: Rakshasa
entries.en: I will become your mask. Now then,[n]let's begin the party of destruction.

entries.speaker: Mokoi
entries.en: I am the soul of your shadow...[n]So that would be why I'm[n]becoming your mask...

entries.speaker: Forneus
entries.en: Now that I am your mask... the hidden[n]arias shall be yours...

entries.speaker: Setanta
entries.en: If anyone dares bring you trouble,[n]I'll gladly choke them to death.

entries.speaker: Titania
entries.en: I will become your mask. Now, let us[n]enjoy a midsummer night's dream.

entries.speaker: Incubus
entries.en: Now that you've got me within your[n]mask, you're never gonna get a wink[n]of sleep again!

entries.speaker: Oni
entries.en: Now that you and me are buddies,[n]I'm gonna eat anyone who even tries[n]to get in our way!

entries.speaker: Lilith
entries.en: I will be your mask from here forward...[n]This will be a night you'll never forget...

entries.speaker: Rangda
entries.en: I'm gonna become your mask, okay?[n]Just don't go dying on me!

entries.speaker: Makami
entries.en: Me be your mask and howl at enemies!

entries.speaker: Parvati
entries.en: I shall become your mask and grant[n]you a blessing as expansive as a vast[n]mountain range.

entries.speaker: Gabriel
entries.en: As your mask, I now declare the birth[n]of your newfound power...

entries.speaker: Zaou-Gongen
entries.en: I shall lend thee the power of three[n]divinities. I am another angry mask[n]of thee...

entries.speaker: Alice
entries.en: Heehee! I think I'll be your mask...[n]You'll play with me, won't you?

entries.speaker: Kali
entries.en: With this mask, my uncontrollable[n]rage is now within your grasp!

entries.speaker: Kurama Tengu
entries.en: It looks like I'm your mask now, so[n]I guess I get to train you as much as[n]I want.

entries.speaker: Oberon
entries.en: I suppose I'm not unwilling to lend[n]you the power of the fairy king...

entries.speaker: Shiki-Ouji
entries.en: You have that mask in your heart.[n]That means you my peer!

entries.speaker: Yamata-no-Orochi
entries.en: My power overflow like flood.[n]With that mask, it be yours...

entries.speaker: Orobas
entries.en: I'll become your mask and show you[n]the truth of the future you want.

entries.speaker: Hanuman
entries.en: With that mask, the power of my[n]adept swordsmanship is yours!

entries.speaker: Archangel
entries.en: Being in possession of that mask means[n]you are also in possession of my blessing.

entries.speaker: Obariyon
entries.en: I've got your back as long as you have[n]that mask, mister!

entries.speaker: Queen Mab
entries.en: Wielder of my mask, you shall soon[n]understand the true might of the[n]fairy queen...

entries.speaker: Sandalphon
entries.en: As the bearer of my mask, your prayers[n]grant me strength. Come, let us fight[n]together.

entries.speaker: Abaddon
entries.en: The strength of the abyss is yours[n]for the taking...

entries.speaker: Shiisaa
entries.en: You have mask... You and me...[n]Don't worry, be happy!

entries.speaker: Sandman
entries.en: Your owning that mask makes you[n]particularly special. I'll give you[n]some good dreams tonight!

entries.speaker: Belial
entries.en: When you fight and when you fall...[n]I, your mask, shall be by your side...

entries.speaker: Leanan Sidhe
entries.en: I'll never leave your side. This mask[n]is proof of that... *giggle*

entries.speaker: Cybele
entries.en: I'll hunt you down and skin you if[n]you dare cheat on me. I'm your[n]mask now... You better be ready.

entries.speaker: Chernobog
entries.en: Let my dark powers corrupt us both...[n]Anything is possible with you, bearer[n]of my mask...

entries.speaker: Flauros
entries.en: I shall become a fiery mask of thine,[n]with my powers to see the past and[n]future...

entries.speaker: Ippon-Datara
entries.en: You having that mask means I need to[n]temper it!

entries.speaker: Orthrus
entries.en: That mask means you my master.[n]Me become loyal guard dog!

entries.speaker: Succubus
entries.en: You want to be with me so much you're[n]making me a mask? Sure, do whatever[n]your heart desires.

entries.speaker: Mothman
entries.en: What... am I? Oh yeah, me a mask[n]you have...

entries.speaker: Dominion
entries.en: The holy power to strike down the[n]darkness has now become one with[n]your mask...

entries.speaker: Nekomata
entries.en: If you take care of this mask, I'll fulfill[n]my end of the bargain.

entries.speaker: Black Frost
entries.en: I'm gonna be-hee your mask, ho![n]Nice to mee-hee-t you, ho!

entries.speaker: Arahabaki
entries.en: You too hate blind obedience?[n]Then let us go together...

entries.speaker: Angel
entries.en: I shall become your mask. Now, let us[n]raise the flag of justice into the sky[n]together.

entries.speaker: Skadi
entries.en: I have come from the darkness within[n]your heart to bestow power upon you...[n]Now, take my mask...

entries.speaker: Kikuri-Hime
entries.en: I shall be your mask and guide you[n]along the border between life and[n]death...

entries.speaker: Chi You
entries.en: By wielding this mask, you shall gain[n]the power to invent a vast multitude[n]of destructive weapons.

entries.speaker: Power
entries.en: I shall become one with this mask[n]and protect you with my life as though[n]I were an iron shield.

entries.speaker: Inugami
entries.en: If you burn for revenge, I will gladly[n]fulfill that desire... Now, take this mask...

entries.speaker: Nebiros
entries.en: I will become your new mask and[n]take control of your destiny...

entries.speaker: Slime
entries.en: Y-You... have mask! N-N-Nice meet you...

entries.speaker: Anzu
entries.en: If you have the mask, then let us[n]ascend together to the apex...

entries.speaker: Yatagarasu
entries.en: Can you sense this noble aura? In that[n]case, I shall become a mask and lead[n]you on... Follow me.

entries.speaker: Yoshitsune
entries.en: I see you know of my ingenious feats.[n]Rejoice, for I shall graciously[n]become your mask...

entries.speaker: Take-Minakata
entries.en: I will become your new mask and free[n]your heart from the chains that keep[n]its power in check...

entries.speaker: Ame-no-Uzume
entries.en: I shall be your new face. Now, come—let[n]us rejoice in the melody that draws forth[n]true might.

entries.speaker: Kushinada
entries.en: It is time I become a new mask and free[n]the pristine power hidden within your[n]mortal flesh...

entries.speaker: Kumbhanda
entries.en: It seems now that I am your mask,[n]I can unleash the rage buried deep[n]within this desecrated soul!

entries.speaker: Ongyo-Ki
entries.en: Heh, it seems as though you can see[n]me... Just as I would expect from he[n]who holds the mask...

entries.speaker: Kin-Ki
entries.en: If you possess the mask, I will grant you[n]the power of an unyielding heart...

entries.speaker: Sui-Ki
entries.en: Overflowing power has joined you[n]along with that new mask...

entries.speaker: Fuu-Ki
entries.en: I'll become one of your masks and work[n]as though I were a raging thunderstorm[n]within your heart!

entries.speaker: Jatayu
entries.en: I will gladly sacrifice my body to help[n]you. If it brings you glory, a new mask[n]I shall become.

entries.speaker: Kaiwan
entries.en: I will become a new mask, and in[n]doing so, change your fate...

entries.speaker: Kelpie
entries.en: Your heart... make me! Now me[n]become mask!

entries.speaker: Thoth
entries.en: I shall become your new mask and[n]work to unleash your inner power.

entries.speaker: Dionysus
entries.en: I shall stay by your side in the form of[n]a mask. Now, show me your power to[n]change yourself in battle!

entries.speaker: Apsaras
entries.en: Allow me to strum out the true emotions[n]of your heart. I shall do so through your[n]new mask...

entries.speaker: Andras
entries.en: You want to make me your mask?[n]You're an odd one. Don't blame me[n]if you end up getting killed.

entries.speaker: Koropokguru
entries.en: So if I'm your mask, we'll be together[n]all the time, huh? Guess I can't slack off...

entries.speaker: Koppa Tengu
entries.en: I'll agree to be your new mask, so don't[n]work me THAT hard, y'hear!?

entries.speaker: Mandrake
entries.en: You know the deadly flower blooming[n]in your heart? That's me! Don't let this[n]mask shrivel up!

entries.speaker: Baal
entries.en: I grant to thee, master of souls, this[n]mask which brings bountiful rain[n]and fertility to the earth...

entries.speaker: Dakini
entries.en: You there, with the new mask![n]Lemme make that power of your[n]heart burn!

entries.speaker: Silky
entries.en: You who has gained a new mask,[n]my master... Allow me to take care[n]of your heart.

entries.speaker: Bugs
entries.en: You the badass with the mask?[n]C'mon, dude, let's play!

entries.speaker: Black Ooze
entries.en: I-I-I... I'll become a mask! Maybe then[n]I will gain shape!

entries.speaker: Bicorn
entries.en: Impure motives are what grant me[n]strength! Here, take care of this[n]mask for me!

entries.speaker: Mithras
entries.en: You who have obtained my mask...[n]I shall become a ray of hope shining[n]deep within your heart.

entries.speaker: Sudama
entries.en: I'll be your mask, man! I'm gonna stop[n]skulking around!

entries.speaker: Kodama
entries.en: I'll turn into a mask and head on out[n]with you! I'm gonna echo inside your[n]heart, bro... Wahoo!

entries.speaker: Agathion
entries.en: I'm gonna be your new mask now![n]Use me, use me, use me!

entries.speaker: Onmoraki
entries.en: I'll be your mask, mister! I'm gonna[n]stay with you, even after you die!

entries.speaker: Nue
entries.en: Me mysterious. Now me new mask.[n]Nice meet you.

entries.speaker: Pisaca
entries.en: You look kinda delicious, but I guess[n]I can pass on eating you since I'm your[n]new mask and all...

entries.speaker: Melchizedek
entries.en: Given that I'm now your new mask,[n]I will protect your justice with the[n]whole of my being.

entries.speaker: Baphomet
entries.en: I think I'm turning into your mask.[n]With our powers combined...

entries.speaker: Raja Naga
entries.en: The power of my clan has now been[n]imbued into your mask!

entries.speaker: Naga
entries.en: I'm your mask now, so you should be[n]able to rely on me—well, as much as[n]you would a weather report...

entries.speaker: Garuda
entries.en: I shall become your mask and raise[n]your heart to the highest celestial[n]plateau.

entries.speaker: Moloch
entries.en: Your soul shall burn a brilliant crimson[n]with my hellfire. Now... take up your[n]mask.

entries.speaker: Norn
entries.en: To you with the mask... I wish good[n]fortune upon thee.

entries.speaker: Belphegor
entries.en: You're a guy, right? In that case, I guess[n]I don't mind becoming your mask and[n]joining up with you...

entries.speaker: Berith
entries.en: There is no need to fear, master of[n]souls... I wholeheartedly pledge my[n]loyalty to you, as your mask.

entries.speaker: Choronzon
entries.en: To think another would summon me...[n]Here, I will grant you the power of evil[n]within this mask.

entries.speaker: Nigi Mitama
entries.en: Kindness is a blessing of repose. I shall[n]become a mask and grant tranquility[n]to your soul...

entries.speaker: Kushi Mitama
entries.en: I'll bring some vigor back to your body.[n]Come on, let's check out the mysterious[n]nature of this world!

entries.speaker: Ara Mitama
entries.en: Go wild! Ferocity is my true power![n]Carve my savage anger into that face[n]of yours!

entries.speaker: Saki Mitama
entries.en: Love and sympathy are all you need[n]in life. I shall become your mask and[n]guide you to intense passion...

entries.speaker: Shiva
entries.en: I shall display my powers of destruction[n]and rebirth. Let us use this mask and[n]dance together...

entries.speaker: Michael
entries.en: In the name of the light within you,[n]I shall become your mask.

entries.speaker: Asura
entries.en: This light of mine that destroyeth all[n]shall become part of thine mask and[n]bestow power upon thee.

entries.speaker: Mada
entries.en: This infinite well of power... which can[n]swallow the universe... shall become[n]your mask...

entries.speaker: Mother Harlot
entries.en: Impurity is beauty, beauty is strength,[n]and strength is in you. I am the impure[n]queen, your mask...

entries.speaker: Clotho
entries.en: Spin and spin, the thread of fate...[n]I am the mask which can see your past...

entries.speaker: Lachesis
entries.en: The thread of fate is measured by my[n]hand... I am the mask which determines[n]your future...

entries.speaker: Atropos
entries.en: Snip it goes, the thread of fate... I am[n]the mask which will see out your life...

entries.speaker: Ardha
entries.en: Thou hast obtained the might of the[n]entire universe. Let us rejoice together,[n]thou and I.

entries.speaker: Vishnu
entries.en: Maintaining the universe, crushing evil...[n]I am the manifestation of thine heart,[n]thine invincible mask.

entries.speaker: Hariti
entries.en: I shall become a mask of affection to[n]guard you, like a mother watching[n]over her weak child...

entries.speaker: Yurlungur
entries.en: I bestow upon thine mask a strength[n]which can conjoin the heavens and[n]the earth.

entries.speaker: Hecatoncheires
entries.en: These one hundred hands which have[n]emerged victorious in countless wars[n]are now held within your mask!

entries.speaker: Satanael
entries.en: You would slay gods to protect the[n]justice you believe in... Very well.[n]I shall once again become your mask.

entries.speaker: Orpheus
entries.en: You would like me to become your[n]mask? Well then, let us search for[n]the answers of life together.

entries.speaker: Thanatos
entries.en: I am born from thee, and with thee[n]I shall walk this earth...

entries.speaker: Izanagi
entries.en: Open thine eyes... Thou shalt arise!

entries.speaker: Magatsu-Izanagi
entries.en: He who shineth light upon abundant[n]darkness... Darest thou make even[n]nothingness into thine object?

entries.speaker: Magatsu-Izanagi
entries.en: I am [clr 1][var 1][clr 27].[n]I shall bear witness to thy journey.

entries.speaker: Kaguya
entries.en: O radiant heart that shineth into the[n]night... I shall become thy strength...

entries.speaker: Kaguya
entries.en: I am [clr 1][var 1][clr 27].[n]Thy light shalt never be extinguished[n]as long as I live.

entries.speaker: Ariadne
entries.en: I'm the goddess who's going to bring[n]victory upon you by acting as your mask!

entries.speaker: Asterius
entries.en: Become your mask? *chuckle* Very[n]well, but if you let your guard drop,[n]I shall crush you!

entries.speaker: Tsukiyomi
entries.en: Madness in my right hand, tenacity in[n]my left... Now then, who shall I break[n]apart first!?

entries.speaker: Messiah
entries.en: From here forward, I shall exist[n]together with you...

entries.speaker: Messiah Picaro
entries.en: In becoming the mask of the Trickster,[n]I have agreed to exist beside you from[n]now on...

entries.speaker: Orpheus Picaro
entries.en: You want me to be the mask of the[n]Trickster, hm? Okay, I guess I can[n]help you clear your name.

entries.speaker: Thanatos Picaro
entries.en: I am born from thee, and with thee[n]I shall walk this earth... I shall be[n]the mask of the Trickster...

entries.speaker: M. Izanagi Picaro
entries.en: He who shineth light upon abundant[n]darkness... Darest thou make even[n]nothingness into thine object?

entries.speaker: M. Izanagi Picaro
entries.en: I am [clr 1][var 1][clr 27].[n]I shall bear witness to thy journey.

entries.speaker: Kaguya Picaro
entries.en: O radiant heart that shineth into the[n]night... I shall become thy strength,[n]Trickster...

entries.speaker: Kaguya Picaro
entries.en: I am [clr 1][var 1][clr 27].[n]Thy light shalt never be extinguished[n]as long as I live.

entries.speaker: Ariadne Picaro
entries.en: Fight onward, Trickster-san! I'll turn[n]into a mask and follow you wherever[n]you go!

entries.speaker: Asterius Picaro
entries.en: So the Trickster wants me to be his[n]mask? Sounds good to me... I'll destroy[n]any who cross you!

entries.speaker: Tsukiyomi Picaro
entries.en: I'm becoming the Trickster's mask?[n]Either way, I'm gonna bring the pain[n]like I always do!

entries.speaker: Arsène
entries.en: I am the pillager of twilight—[clr 1][var 1][clr 27]!

entries.speaker: Arsène
entries.en: You need my help once more?[n]Very well, use my power wisely.

entries.speaker: Satan
entries.en: I am [clr 1][var 1][clr 27],[n]the judge of all things.

entries.speaker: Satan
entries.en: O sinner who knoweth not the true[n]meaning of fear... I shall be thy mask[n]and bear witness to the end.

entries.speaker: Lucifer
entries.en: I am [clr 1][var 1][clr 27],[n]the morning star that riseth[n]from the darkness.

entries.speaker: Lucifer
entries.en: He who transcendeth the bleak world[n]of the heart... Under the pact, I shall[n]become thy mask.

entries.speaker: Kohryu
entries.en: The might to move all creation shall[n]now become thy mask.

entries.speaker: Okuninushi
entries.en: My sword, my bow... These tools which[n]formed this fine land shall now grant[n]you power as a mask.

entries.speaker: Futsunushi
entries.en: I am the god of the swords which once[n]conquered this land. I shall temper the[n]blade of your heart.

entries.speaker: Seth
entries.en: So you wish for the power to kill, even[n]if others abhor you? In that case, I shall[n]become your mask.

entries.speaker: Ishtar
entries.en: I am the one who accepts the love of[n]all men. Of course, I accept yours as[n]well, as your mask...

entries.speaker: Surt
entries.en: Through my mask, you shall burn the[n]power of my world-consuming flames[n]into your eyes...

entries.speaker: Siegfried
entries.en: Your soul shall act as a tool to transform[n]my dauntless might into an unstoppable[n]mask.

entries.speaker: Lakshmi
entries.en: Enough admiring my beauty... It is time[n]I become your mask and teach you the[n]joy-bringing dance...

entries.speaker: Fortuna
entries.en: Your luck's gonna come. It will, it will![n]Anyways, here's your mask of fortune.

entries.speaker: Suzaku
entries.en: The burning light that illuminates[n]the future is now your new mask...

entries.speaker: Seiryu
entries.en: The most noble power of the four holy[n]beasts shall become a mask to be[n]bestowed upon this youth...

entries.speaker: Genbu
entries.en: I shall become a mask and make use[n]of my wisdom to create a profitable[n]future for you.

entries.speaker: Byakko
entries.en: Mine roar causeth all beasts to[n]bow down! I shall be thy mask!

entries.speaker: Bishamonten
entries.en: Your foes are nothing before my might.[n]I shall become a mask and grant you[n]new power!

entries.speaker: Koumokuten
entries.en: Leave keeping watch over monsters to[n]me... In exchange, I grant you a mask[n]that monitors the world...

entries.speaker: Jikokuten
entries.en: Peace and security are my duties...[n]I shall be your mask and grant you[n]my power!

entries.speaker: Zouchouten
entries.en: My power to encourage growth in all[n]who worship me shall become a mask[n]and protect your soul...

entries.speaker: Hell Biker
entries.en: Hatred and violence are the best,[n]don't you think? Wear my mask and[n]let's kick it on over to hell!

entries.speaker: Daisoujou
entries.en: You with the body immune to rot...[n]Let us welcome the impending day[n]of salvation together as one...

entries.speaker: Trumpeter
entries.en: The ring of my trumpet signals calamity[n]and death... I shall be your mask, so let[n]us harmonize...

entries.speaker: White Rider
entries.en: The power to call forth decisive victory[n]is now yours in the form of my mask...

entries.speaker: Matador
entries.en: This body of mine, born from the[n]bloody throes of battle, shall be[n]with you as a mask from now on.

entries.speaker: Pale Rider
entries.en: Your mask shall be imbued with the[n]power to bring forth deadly curses[n]from the underworld.

entries.speaker: Horus
entries.en: I'll be your mask from now on![n]Let's fly together into the light!

entries.speaker: Attis
entries.en: I shall unleash the magical energy of[n]the blood that has been spilt... Now[n]then, take my mask.

entries.speaker: Sraosha
entries.en: My ears shall receive all of your wishes.[n]I will become a mask and reward your[n]noble soul.

entries.speaker: Mitra
entries.en: I am the one who keeps watch over[n]all oaths of this world, and the one[n]who shall become your mask...

entries.speaker: Phoenix
entries.en: I am the true master of all winged[n]beasts... and so, I shall become a mask[n]and bestow peace upon thee...

entries.speaker: Principality
entries.en: Order and discipline come before[n]anything else. Take my mask, and[n]let us defend our honor together.

entries.speaker: Neko Shogun
entries.en: Your future shines bright like a[n]diamond! I am your mask now!

entries.speaker: Vasuki
entries.en: Filth is my power, and therefore thine[n]as well. Here, I grant thee this mask of[n]impurity.

entries.speaker: Ananta
entries.en: The power of creation that has awakened[n]inside of you shall henceforth be within[n]your mask.

entries.speaker: Throne
entries.en: I shall assist you in guarding your regal[n]authority. Please take me with you as[n]your mask.

entries.speaker: Quetzalcoatl
entries.en: I bring fertility, and shall lead you to[n]the future. This fruitful body shall now[n]be your mask.

entries.speaker: Red Rider
entries.en: I shall become your mask and show you[n]the authority I hold over the dogs of war...

entries.speaker: Black Rider
entries.en: I shall become your mask and display[n]my ability to bring true calamity to[n]even your worst foes...

entries.speaker: Pazuzu
entries.en: I shall become your mask. Now, let us[n]walk together and take the reins of[n]this desert world.

entries.speaker: Maria
entries.en: Please, allow me to become your mask[n]so that I may guard your compassionate[n]heart.

entries.speaker: Vohu Manah
entries.en: I shall become your mask and[n]illuminate the darkness.

entries.speaker: Cait Sith
entries.en: With mew as your mask, you've got[n]nothing to worry about meow!

entries.speaker: Mishaguji
entries.en: Now that you possess my mask, I shall[n]bestow upon you the power of nature.

entries.speaker: Loa
entries.en: Hmph, I suppose I'll be your mask.[n]Together, we shall drink, sing, and[n]dance like there's no tomorrow.

entries.speaker: Chimera
entries.en: Perhaps I should become your mask[n]and let my grotesque body rest...

entries.speaker: Atavaka
entries.en: As your mask, I shall eradicate those[n]malevolent spirits that seek out your[n]demise.

entries.speaker: Izanagi-no-Okami
entries.en: From the very moment of my[n]emergence, I have been a guiding[n]light shed to illuminate thy path...

entries.speaker: Athena
entries.en: My mask shall be the shield that[n]protects you.

entries.speaker: Raoul
entries.en: How delightful! You've awakened my[n]true form. Very well, walk your chosen[n]path without fear of mistake!

entries.speaker: Orpheus
entries.en: I am to become your mask?[n]Then I shall walk by thy side[n]and find the answer to life.

entries.speaker: Izanagi-no-Okami Pic.
entries.en: Thou shalt be the Trickster's mask,[n]and I will be a guiding light shed[n]to illuminate thy path...

entries.speaker: Athena Picaro
entries.en: I shall become the Trickster's mask[n]and a shield to protect you.

entries.speaker: Orpheus Picaro
entries.en: I am to become the mask of the[n]Trickster? That's fine. I shall help[n]you clear your name.

entries.speaker: Macabre
entries.en: Fine then... I suppose I'll become[n]your mask and lead you in this[n]dance of death.

entries.speaker: Alilat
entries.en: I'll become a sturdy mask and keep[n]you safe!

entries.speaker: Thunderbird
entries.en: You able to use power of spirit bird!?

entries.speaker: Fafnir
entries.en: As long as you wield my mask, the[n]gold will be ours for the taking...

entries.speaker: Byakhee
entries.en: If you so desire, me will fight with soul[n]you have!

entries.speaker: Hastur
entries.en: Darkness is beginning and end![n]Use my mask and conquer world!

entries.speaker: Tam Lin
entries.en: Beckon me when you need my[n]assistance. I shall cut you a path!

entries.speaker: Throne
entries.en: I shall watch over your path of[n]progression. Please take me as[n]a mask.

entries.speaker: Surt
entries.en: Through my mask, you shall burn the[n]power of my world-consuming flames[n]into your eyes...

entries.speaker: Loa
entries.en: Hmph, I suppose I'll be your mask.[n]Together, we shall drink, sing, and[n]dance like there's no tomorrow.

entries.speaker: Chimera
entries.en: You think you can control body[n]you have fused!?

entries.speaker: Atavaka
entries.en: As your mask, I shall eradicate those[n]malevolent spirits that seek out your[n]demise.

entries.speaker: Cait Sith
entries.en: With mew as your mask, you've got[n]nothing to worry about meow!

entries.speaker: Siegfried
entries.en: Your soul shall act as a tool to transform[n]my dauntless might into an unstoppable[n]mask.
